speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for your response. To begin our assessment, have you experienced any fever, abdominal pain, or blood in your stool recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea caused by *Clostridioides difficile*.

Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin and the severity of your symptoms, I suspect you have a *C. diff* infection. I am requesting the results of a stool *C. difficile* toxin assay and ordering images to check for any complications like colitis. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_Difficile_Toxin_Assay. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_XRay.
